name: Naturopathic practice

pf.license.need: Optional, and Rosie checks nothing. The practice may list each practitioner's license or credential, where the state licenses the work, and any insurance it carries; Rosie shows what the practice enters, as given.
pf.license.ask: Optional: each practitioner's license or credential and its end date, as the practice keeps them.
pf.license.who holds it: The practice; each practitioner; each wellness coach.
pf.license.how it's checked: Rosie does not check, look up or verify any license, credential or insurance (D96). The practice's own word only.
pf.license.blocks going live: None for a license: nothing is held back because a credential is not on the page.
pf.license.renewals: None tracked by Rosie; the practice keeps its own dates.
pf.license.insurance or bond: Optional: the practice may list its liability insurance; Rosie does not check it.
pf.license.background check: The practice's own choice; Rosie does not run one.
pf.license.own word: If the practice says a visit needs a credential a person doesn't have, that person isn't offered that visit (the practice's own word, not a check).

pf.services.shape: Naturopathic practice: a first consult for a health plan built on food, sleep, movement and natural remedies; follow-up visits; a wellness coach visit; in person at the practice, by video where the practitioner is licensed where the patient is during the visit, and at home in a few places.
pf.services.examples: The example practice's own self-pay prices, not a standard. Plans rarely pay for naturopathic care here; a self-pay price is the default.

pf.questions.whoMayBook: An adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for a child, who stays; a health care agent for an adult who can't consent; a doctor's office for its patient.

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, a stroke sign, or a fainting spell now
stop.say: Call 911 now. A naturopathic visit is not for an emergency.

stop.words: crisis words, or thoughts of harming yourself

goOn.what: no remedy or fasting plan until the practitioner OKs it; the practitioner asks again at the visit

goOn.words: a prescription medicine, or a serious condition such as heart disease, cancer, diabetes, kidney or liver disease
goOn.what: the practitioner reviews it before any remedy is suggested; a change to a prescription comes only from the patient's own doctor
a parent or guardian books and stays; the practice's own rules for children apply

pf.safety.medical questions: Never answered: whether a remedy treats a condition, whether to stop or start a medicine, or what a test means. Those go to the practitioner or the patient's own doctor. Rosie gives no health advice and makes no claim that a remedy works.

required.name: Intake form
required.who: the patient, on the secure page
required.result: the practitioner reads it before the visit; a flag moves the visit to the practitioner

required.name: Health history and medicines
required.who: the patient, on the secure page
required.result: the practitioner OKs any remedy before it is suggested

required.name: Doctor's note (where the practice asks for one)
required.result: not in by the day before: the desk calls the doctor's office; still not in, the visit can move with no fee

pf.first_steps.prep for the reminder: On a secure link: what to bring (a photo ID, the list of medicines and supplements, the plan card, any food diary the practitioner asked for).
pf.first_steps.prep timing: Usually none. A lab test, if the practitioner orders one, may need fasting from the night before; that prep is on the secure link.

pf.visit.check-in: The check-in code at the front desk. A video visit: the code is read out at the start.
pf.visit.at the visit: The practitioner checks the intake form and the health history before any remedy. A chaperone is offered for any hands-on work.
pf.visit.work changes: A new remedy or a new lab test comes only from the practitioner; the desk never adds one on its own.
pf.visit.stops: A pregnancy, a flag the practitioner won't clear, or a missed fast for a lab test: the visit doesn't go ahead; another time, with no fee.
pf.visit.what proves it's done: The code, or DONE when the visit ends.
pf.visit.results: Lab results and the practitioner's notes stay in the practice's own records and portal. Rosie never texts a result.

pf.money.before: Nothing taken at booking (the starting answer). No card is saved unless the owner turns on the no-show fee.
pf.money.after: At the practice: paid at the front desk after the visit, card or cash, the practice's own way. At home: one bill from Rosie after the visit, with the trip fee in it; a plan's share billed by the practice its own way.
pf.money.fees: A no-show or a late cancel within 24 hours: $40, only if the owner says yes, and only where a card was saved at booking.
pf.money.rosfield: Rosfield's $2 per booking applies as for every business (D97); the practice pays it, never the patient.

pf.messages.never in a text: The concern, the remedy, the medicine, the test, the reason for the visit, and any health history. Texts name only the practice, the date, the time, the place and a secure link; staff and owner texts use initials.
pf.messages.results: Never in a text; 'your practitioner has the report' at most, only where the patient agreed.
pf.messages.languages: English and Spanish, plus the practice's interpreter line.
pf.messages.minors: A parent or guardian books; texts go to them.

pf.staff.roles: Naturopathic practitioners (as licensed where the state licenses the work), wellness coaches, and the front desk.
pf.staff.supervision: A remedy decision is the practitioner's alone; a coach gives no medical advice.
pf.staff.skills: each person's visit kinds, as the practice lists them
pf.staff.who OKs: The practitioner OKs every remedy and any flag; a coach doesn't.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Another practitioner or coach with the same skill. A patient who asked for a woman or a man is asked before anyone else is booked; nobody moves on silence.
pf.staff.chaperone: Offered for any hands-on work; a patient's request is honored.

pf.rules.orders: No remedy or plan without the intake form and the health history.
pf.rules.health privacy: The practice signs Rosie's health-privacy agreement before going live.
pf.rules.claims: No claim in any text or booking page that a remedy treats or cures a condition.
pf.rules.results: Lab results and notes go to the patient through the practice's own portal; Rosie never carries them.
pf.rules.records: Records kept as long as the state's rules require, in the practice's own system; a patient's copy within 30 days.
pf.rules.minors: Who may consent for a child, and what a minor may consent to alone: the practice's own rule, from the state's form.
pf.rules.video: A video visit only where the practitioner is licensed where the patient is during the visit.

matter most.no intake form on the day: The desk calls; no form, no visit, no fee.
matter most.a flag the practitioner won't clear: The visit moves to a call with the practitioner, with no fee.
matter most.could be pregnant: Stopped until the practitioner OKs it.
matter most.a prescription change asked: The patient's own doctor decides; the practitioner is told.
matter most.results questions: The practitioner, or the patient's doctor.

pf.edges.the rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.
